A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 20-page versions of the same MM-Spatial/CA-VQA work. The main text, Figures 1–8, Tables 1–11, and Appendices A–E are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MM-Spatial benchmark and depth-estimation results in Section 5, plus data-mixture, general-capability, and blind-filtering results in Appendices B–D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, including CA-VQA, CV-Bench, SpatialRGPT-Bench, and the appendix data-mixture and blind-filtering analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendix A retain the same data-generation pipeline, MM1.5-based architecture, multi-view inputs, CoT depth prediction, and depth tool-use/full-encoding variants.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage is unchanged, including CA-VQA, its AABB-aligned variant, OSD, CV-Bench, SpatialRGPT-Bench, and the general-capability benchmarks. Both versions include the same indoor/outdoor scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments in Tables 2–11, including MM1.5, GPT-4/V/4o, SpatialRGPT variants, Cambrian, and DepthPro where applicable.

E3.justification: Both retain 1/0.1-FPS training/evaluation sampling, 672×672 image resolution, up to four support views, and identical metrics, filtering procedures, data mixtures, and scale-augmentation settings.

E4.justification: The same CoT/depth/multi-view comparisons, indoor/outdoor analyses, scale-augmentation tests, data-mixture ablations (Table 7), blind-filtering analysis (Table 11), and qualitative examples are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report results without repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout Tables 2–11 and Figure 4. For example, Table 3's MM-Spatial-3B average remains 47.0, and Table 5's generalist CoT depth accuracy remains 84.6.

T1.justification: Appendix A's distance, size, and grounding definitions and Appendix E/Figure 8's bounding-box geometry remain unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions: CA-VQA, strong spatial performance while preserving general capabilities, and benefits from depth and multi-view inputs. The new resource link does not alter these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning language bias, metric versus relative depth, bounding-box definition mismatch, and outdoor generalization are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same qualifications about CoT for 3D grounding.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the promise to publish the SFT dataset and benchmark with the apple/ml-cubifyanything repository URL. This adds a concrete resource pointer; implementation disclosures otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish the repository's contents or availability.

R1.justification: Section 2, Table 1, and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. The project URL adds access information rather than related-work coverage.

P1.justification: v2 corrects quotation marks, adds emphasis in Appendix B, changes its 'Appendix C' reference to 'Sec. C,' and updates the abstract and version header. The narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The abstract has small spacing and line-wrapping changes around the new URL, and Appendix B's emphasis changes cause local reflow. Figures and tables retain their content, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: Replacing the abstract's future-release promise with a concrete project URL modestly improves resource-access documentation, alongside minor typographic refinements. Scientific methods, evidence, and limitations are unchanged, so the gain is limited. The PDFs alone do not verify the linked resources.
